summary: BC Environment’s flag-years mark: a supplied vector reconstruction from a scan of an undated cover (reference/supplied-cover-scan.png), built on the gallery’s own flag artwork with outlined Helvetica Bold lettering. See package-README.md, BC_Environment_Validation.json and review/BC_Environment_Comparison.png.

assets.label: BC Environment: the flag symbol and wordmark
assets.publisher: Ministry of Environment, Province of British Columbia
assets.sourceLocator: An undated printed cover, supplied to the project as a scan (reference/supplied-cover-scan.png, 594 × 446 px); its title and date are not in the picture
assets.dateNote: The cover is undated. “BC Environment” beside the flag symbol places it in the flag years; the Ministry of Environment of 1988–1991, between Environment and Parks and Environment, Lands and Parks, is the ministry of that name, which is where it is placed. Whether the name and mark carried on under Environment, Lands and Parks from 1991 is not established.
assets.notes: “BC” in bold sans serif beside the flag symbol, with “Environment” below, tightly set. Printed in cream on a green band running diagonally across a cover photograph; drawn here upright in one dark ink.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: the flag symbol is the gallery’s own twelve-path flag (src/assets/flagMark.js) placed as one unit, and the 13 letters are outlines of the site’s Helvetica Bold, each fitted to the scan, the lower line tightly spaced as printed. Against the scan’s cream ink the silhouettes overlap by 82.6 percent (intersection over union; lettering 85 percent, the flag 69 percent, whose fine separations the print fills in). Cream #F7F3D6 and green #5EBD7E are sampled from a textured scan, not colour specifications.
